title: CareerLens Multi-Agent Task Contract v1
rules: Children receive separate agent sessions; child histories are never merged into the parent or siblings.
A parent task has no model turn; it waits durably and projects bounded child results only.
Result projection preserves at most 2000 characters and only citations that still exist for the same user.
Cancelling a parent cancels every descendant task and each queued or running agent run.
Budget is cumulative across attempts; a restart or provider usage gap never resets it.
A repeated sync of the same run/attempt is deduplicated by (last_run_id,last_attempt), so scheduler retry cannot double-count tokens.
Role tool scopes are enforced by the gateway, not by model-supplied arguments.
